projects.title: C-flat Compiler
projects.description: - Developed lexer, LL(1) recursive descent parser, validator, optimizer, and x86-64 code generator in C++.

projects.title: Real-Time High-Quality Rendering Techniques
projects.description: - Implemented percentage-closer soft shadows and screen-space directional occlusion with >30 FPS.- Developed ray-traced video denoiser via a joint-bilateral filter and temporal accumulation with >30 FPS.- Utilized GNU Make and C++ while learning OpenGL, GLSL, and Blender from scratch.

projects.title: Slang Tracker
projects.description: - Built a tool to identify and track slang in real-time on online forums, then predict current and future trends.- Gaining experience with NLP: text normalizing, tokenizing, statistical analysis, and linguistic perspectives on slang.- Technologies: Python, Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK), Regex, Web Scraping, Matplotlib.

projects.title: MIPS Emulator
projects.description: - Designed MIPS simulator from scratch in C++, supporting 21 instructions, stack manipulation, and jump directives.- Gained a deep understanding of fetch/execute cycle, CPU memory management, and endianness.

projects.title: Carrom AI Agent
projects.description: - Developed reinforcement learning AI agent to play South-Asian tabletop board game Carrom (similar to billiards).- Studied theory via David Silver’s virtual RL course, then applied concepts to achieve win rate of >50% vs. random.- Technologies: Reinforcement Learning, AI/ML, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Python, Pygame, Pymunk, PettingZoo, Gymnasium, Ray RLlib, Ray Tune.

projects.title: Verde
projects.description: - Built a social media app encouraging users to complete daily sustainability challenges via public posts.- 1st place winner at UCSB Solution Challenge competition; collaborated with a team of 4 members.- Technologies: React Native, Firebase, Expo, Typescript, Git.

projects.title: Bird Flocking Simulation
projects.description: - Built a web demonstration of Craig Reynolds’ artificial life simulation of boids (bird-oid objects).- Technologies: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, GitHub Pages.

projects.title: AlgoU
projects.description: - Built a full-stack web app to teach users to code common sorting algorithms through a visual interface.- Presented project to student and mentor community at Polygence Symposium of Rising Scholars.- Technologies: React, NodeJS, PostgreSQL, Docker, Apache, Bootstrap, HTML, JavaScript, Python.

projects.title: PA28 Performance
projects.description: - Implemented production-level aircraft performance app under the guidance of mentor Steve Kleiman.- Deployed to iOS, Android, and browser, accumulating 2500 active users and hosting 2300 sessions/month.- Technologies: HTML, JavaScript, Chrome DevTools.
